rules.name: Combined Rating Calculation Validation
rules.rule: Combined rating must be calculated using VA Schedule table per 38 CFR §4.25

rules.name: Individual Ratings Must Sum Correctly
rules.rule: Verify that individual condition ratings, when combined using VA tables, equal the stated combined rating

rules.name: Effective Date Logic Validation
rules: Effective date cannot be in the future
Effective date for increase must be on or after claim date
Effective date for reduction must follow established rating

rules.name: No Duplicate Service-Connected Conditions
rules.rule: Same condition cannot appear twice in service-connected list

rules.name: Condition Cannot Be Denied and Rated
rules.rule: Condition cannot appear in both service-connected and denied lists
